channel.title: The Lowndes Signal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lowndes Signal (lowndessignal.com)

item.title: Extension offers food safety classes in Lowndes County
item.description: Alabama Extension will host January and February food safety classes in Lowndes County for home-based food sellers and restaurant workers; registration required.

item.title: Mosses council funds town improvements
item.description: Mosses council approves over $100K for roads and local groups serving children as a resident challenges the town clerk’s notary status and accuses leaders of fraud, allegations they deny.

item.title: To die in the Lord
item.description: Dean Kelly reflects on Revelation 14 and 1 Thessalonians 4, explaining the hope, blessing, and rest promised to patient, obedient Christians who “die in the Lord.”

item.title: You must decide who you are
item.description: Discover why God repeatedly called Ezekiel “son of man,” how his Babylonian exile shaped his visions of judgment and mercy, and what his message means for your faith today.

item.title: County commission debates Zoom meeting access
item.description: Lowndes County commissioners have halted Zoom access to meetings, sparking debate and confusion as officials weigh legal rules and whether to restore virtual public viewing.

item.title: Athlete voting heats up amid weekend flurries
item.description: Amid weekend flurries, Lowndes County Athlete of the Week voting opens: meet nominees Ryan Simpson, Sarah Beth Murchison and AaLyria Sanders, and vote hourly through Tuesday at noon.

item.title: Humility Needed in the Pulpit and Pew
item.description: From music disputes to “ego on parade,” pastor Michael J. Brooks uses real church conflicts to show why humility — on the platform and in the pews — is essential to resisting spiritual harm.

item.title: Reaching for Ruth-like faith
item.description: A local pastor reflects on Ruth’s trust in God, his own struggle to match it, and the call to follow God amid uncertainty when the path ahead is unclear.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Upcoming faith events in Lowndes County: prayer nights, Valentine’s banquet, Black History Month program, wild game supper, plus how to submit your church activities.

item.title: Beulah congregation blesses Calhoun track program
item.description: Beulah Primitive Baptist Church continues its annual support of The Calhoun School, donating $1,260 to the track and field team during a joint worship service.
